questions_resolved.question: When a brief is approved, how would you like section corrections to be recorded in the correction_log table?
questions_resolved.answer: Log all 11 sections per approval with a has_changed boolean flag (provides complete baseline data for unaltered sections as well as edits)

questions_resolved.question: What context should each record in the exported JSONL evaluation dataset include alongside the initial draft and human correction?
questions_resolved.answer: Include the full normalized transcript and confirmed fact quotes for complete prompt context

questions_resolved.question: How should developers or evaluation pipelines export the JSONL benchmark datasets?
questions_resolved.answer: Both REST API endpoints (GET /api/v1/eval/export and GET /api/v1/eval/corrections) and a standalone CLI command (python -m backend.app.eval.export)
